label: Counting cluster inputs
subgoals: Take the union of all inputs read by the cluster's BLEs
Remove the nets produced inside the cluster
Count the remaining nets as required input pins

label: Legality of adding a BLE
subgoals: Add the candidate's external inputs to the imported set
Remove any imported net the candidate itself produces
Accept the candidate only if the count stays within I

label: Absorbed nets
subgoals: Find outputs whose every sink is inside the cluster
Confirm some BLE in the cluster actually reads them
Count those nets as removed from global routing
